main.description: Publish a post gated by a tier. contentLabel drives both entitlement + social dispatch: only 'safe' posts emit a teaser via app.bsky.feed.post. 'adult' posts require caller.contentPolicy='adult_allowed'. body is stored as signal:v1:{ciphertext} when sensitivity>=2 (tier-gated), plaintext when sensitivity=1 (public teaser-safe).

tierRequired.description: tierId required to view. Empty string = public preview only.

teaser.description: Public teaser; always plaintext, no PII/explicit content.

body.description: Full content. Server applies signal:v1 encryption for contentLabel != 'safe'.

priceUsdCents.description: If >0, PPV (pay-per-view) post on top of tier access

teaserPostUri.description: app.bsky.feed.post URI if teaser was dispatched (contentLabel=safe only)

errors.name: TierNotOwned
errors.description: tierRequired does not belong to caller

errors.name: NotCreator
errors.description: caller is not a registered creator
